batch.topic: A customer asks to collect a repaired watch without buying a new strap; distinguish the repair charge from the optional item.
A resident retrieves an umbrella from a shared hallway and leaves someone else’s walking stick where it was; do not infer ownership from location.
An organiser marks one seat as reserved but offers the other seat to a late arrival; preserve the contrast and time sequence.
A parent separates a child’s old notebooks from blank notebooks for next term; the child chooses what to keep before anything is recycled.
